name: causal-impact-campaign
description: Measure the causal impact of marketing campaigns, promos, or interventions on business metrics using Bayesian structural time series. Covers the full pipeline: data exploration, covariate engineering, 9-method analysis (BSTS VI + HMC, CausalPy, RDiT, Conformal, Prophet), 440-spec robustness grid, permutation validation, placebo calibration, methodology communication guide, and client-facing deliverables.
